children: Bengaluru: Mid-size IT services firm Coforge reported a 56.5% year-on-year increase in net profit to 588.1 crore for the second quarter of the fiscal year 2027, aided by a full-quarter contribution from its acquisition of engineering services firm Encora for $2.35 billion.

Sequentially, net profit rose 13.4%. Revenue for the September quarter increased 53.6% year-on-year and 11.6% sequentially to Rs 6,170.8 crore. In dollar terms, revenue stood at $652.2 million, up 10.1% from the preceding quarter on constant currency terms. Contribution from the Encora acquisition was a major reason for the revenue growth this quarter along with large deals. "The demand slowdown that we are talking about is largely on account of the fact that the procurement-driven RFPs have slowed down. The intensity of the ask around delivering AI-led transformation for enterprises is only getting stronger," chief executive officer Sudhir Singh said in the post-earnings analyst call.

title: Coforge Q2 Net Jumps 56.5% to 588 crore on Encora Deal
